description: Create site_pages Supabase table and add /admin/pages CRUD for editable legal/policy pages (Privacy Policy, Terms, Refund Policy, Disclaimer, Cookie Policy)
steps: Create the site_pages table in Supabase via the REST API (use SQL exec or direct insert approach). Schema: id (uuid, default gen_random_uuid()), slug (text, unique, not null), title (text, not null), content (text - markdown), meta_title (text), meta_description (text), is_active (boolean, default true), updated_at (timestamptz, default now()), created_at (timestamptz, default now()). Enable RLS with public SELECT where is_active=true. Save schema as supabase/site_pages_schema.sql.
Insert initial rows for: privacy-policy, terms, refund-policy, disclaimer, cookie-policy. Content can be empty/null initially since pages will fall back to hardcoded content.

Create src/pages/admin/AdminPages.jsx - listing page showing all site_pages with slug, title, status, updated_at. Follow AdminArticles.jsx pattern with edit/delete and + New Page button. Include nav links to other admin sections.

Create src/pages/admin/AdminPageEditor.jsx - create/edit form with: title, slug (auto-generated from title like blog slug), content (RichMarkdownEditor), meta_title, meta_description, is_active. Include live preview.
Register routes in src/App.jsx: lazy-import AdminPages and AdminPageEditor, add routes /admin/pages, /admin/pages/new, /admin/pages/edit/:slug

Modify the legal page components (PrivacyPolicy.jsx, Terms.jsx, RefundPolicy.jsx, Disclaimer.jsx, CookiePolicy.jsx) to fetch content from the site_pages table via the anon supabase client. If content exists in the DB, render it using markdownToBlocks + ArticleBlocks within the LegalLayout structure. If not found or empty, fall back to the existing hardcoded sections array.
Add 'Pages' nav link in the admin panel headers (AdminBlog.jsx, AdminArticles.jsx, AdminJobs.jsx)
acceptance_criteria: site_pages table exists in Supabase with 5 initial rows
/admin/pages/edit/:slug loads and updates existing page content
Legal pages on the public site still render correctly with hardcoded fallback
If content is added to site_pages via admin, those pages show the DB content instead
Build passes with 398 pages and exit code 0
verification: Run: export PATH="/root/.nvm/versions/node/v22.23.2/bin:$PATH" && cd /projects/sandbox/emo-websitenew && rm -rf dist && npm run build
Confirm build exits 0 and produces 398 pages
findings: Build passes with 398 pages. The site_pages table cannot be created programmatically from this environment because: (1) PostgREST REST API does not support DDL operations, (2) the Supabase pooler returns 'tenant/user not found' for this project ref, (3) direct DB connections are refused (IPv6 only, connection refused). The SQL schema is saved at supabase/site_pages_schema.sql and must be executed manually via the Supabase Dashboard SQL Editor. The admin pages handle the missing table gracefully (showing error message), and the legal pages fall back to hardcoded content when the table does not exist or content is empty. This matches the FEAT-001 pattern where the job_openings table was pre-created. Once the table is created and seed data inserted, the full CRUD workflow and DB-content rendering will work.
